evidence.summary: Sensor data for U005 shows position_error_um increased 30.8% (z=2.5) indicating a steady rise; coolant_flow_l_min decreased 2.2% (z=-1.5) and spindle_temp_c rose 1.7% (z=0.8).
RUL estimate indicates 58.4 cycles remaining, policy band above_50_monitor, suggesting the unit is still within normal life but trending anomalies.
SOP-E-302 describes position error increasing slowly and steadily over many cycles as a symptom of axis calibration drift.
Similar unit U050 experienced calibration drift symptoms with position error increase; root cause identified as calibration_drift and action was run_axis_calibration.

report.summary: U005 exhibited a significant rise in position_error_um (30.8% above baseline) with modest increases in spindle temperature and a slight drop in coolant flow. The pattern matches the steady position error increase described in SOP-E-302 for calibration drift. Comparable incidents in fleet history (ticket T1049) were resolved by performing an axis calibration. Given the RUL remains healthy, the likely root cause is calibration drift. Recommended action is to run the axis calibration procedure per SOP-E-302.

hits.title: Axis calibration drift
hits.text: Position error increasing slowly and steadily over many cycles, often after a temperature change; parts drifting toward tolerance limits; no spikes.

hits.title: Position sensor fault: intermittent position error
hits.text: Position error shows sudden spikes well above 10 um that appear and disappear between cycles; other sensors normal; no vibration or temperature change.

hits.title: Position sensor fault: intermittent position error
hits.text: Intermittent spikes without a mechanical signature point to the linear scale reader head, encoder cable or connector. A slow steady increase is calibration drift instead (see SOP-E-302).
